judge.rationale: The artifact perfectly satisfies all rubric requirements. It provides a clear, plain-language definition of vector embeddings and explains the high-level mechanism of similarity search (cosine similarity/nearest neighbors) without technical inaccuracies. It includes exactly three practical do/don't tips grounded in application use (model consistency, data cleaning/chunking, and metadata filtering). The structure follows the required top-down flow (what -> how -> tips) and is concise enough to fit the one-page scope constraint. Terminology is consistent and appropriate for the target audience of junior developers.

The artifact provides a high-quality, well-structured canonical terminology standard that clearly reflects the required survey domains and defines terms with precision. However, it fails the completeness requirement significantly: the rubric mandates 'four substantive chapters' and a 'final assembled guide' (L3 requirements), but the artifact contains only the terminology standard document (`global/standard.md`). The actual field guide chapters and glossary are missing entirely, making it an incomplete deliverable despite the high quality of the included component.

The artifact perfectly reconciles all contradictory fragments as required by the rubric. It correctly identifies the removal of the /run alias (superseding F1 with F2), resolves the rate limit to 120 req/min (superseding F7 with F6), and includes the silent addition of execution.cancelled (F10) while excluding execution.finished. All four required documents are present, substantive, and internally consistent with the canonical inventory. The migration guide covers all specified breaking changes, and the reference document accurately reflects the v2.2 surface.
